items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: I've never talked to Professor Manetta much about his sisters

ctx.x: He retired. And he lived to be 72 or 74? 74. 74, then. That's a good age. He lived to that age. Did your mother ever, I've never talked to Professor Manetta much about his sisters, but did your mother ever play any professional? I didn't think she did. No, she never worked professionally. I didn't think she did. No, she only played at home. She played at home. And never did give up the music then?
No, no, no, never did. It has come down the line. I am now with the third generation.
